scripts.build: npm run build -w @timekeeper/contracts && npm run build -w @timekeeper/server && npm run build -w @timekeeper/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @timekeeper/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @timekeeper/contracts && vitest run apps/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
